第2229章承诺与谎言
看着眼前的王倩，洛千凝眼中尽是怜悯之色。
她终于明白了陈凡口中对方的特殊之处到底在哪。
然而，这对于王倩而言，简直就是一场无与伦比的灾难！
王倩对于自己的情况当然也非常清楚，毕竟她在和陈凡相遇的时候，陈凡就已经告诉过她了，只是不如此刻洛千凝说的这般详细。
“洛仙师果然厉害，我的确是被坑惨了，如今无论是在正道还是魔道眼中，我都如同补品一般，幸亏陈仙师可怜我，为我找的这一处安身立命之所，否则，我恐怕早就已经没命了……”
王倩说到此处，不由黯然神伤。
洛千凝静静看着眼前一幕，心中愈发怜惜，轻声道：“往后安心在此修行，有剑阁剑阵守护，一般人能伤到你分毫，但人是想要从根本上解决问题，你必须要修炼一部强大的魔功，重新洗伐自身才行。”
“强大的魔功……”王倩闻言不禁摇摇头，“谈何容易啊，若是真的遇到了强大的魔仙，恐怕直接会要了我的命！”
洛千凝无奈点头，事实也正如王倩所说的一样，对方现在的情况必须要修炼一种强大的魔功，这样一来才能重新脱胎换骨，将自身修炼《玄妙诀》所造成的问题抵消掉。
可是魔道中人大多行事不择手段，王倩在他们眼中，就如一株绝世仙草一般！
谁会不杀她，反而救她？
这时，陈凡说道：“不必担心，你且在这里安心修行，我说过会帮你到底的，等我遇到韩千陌，便能帮你走出泥潭。”
听到‘韩千陌’这个名字，王倩不由一惊，她之前曾听陈凡说过，会帮自己找一位魔道师父，但那时陈凡并未明说是谁。
此刻，陈凡忽然提到对方名字，王倩瞬间僵在原地，内心震撼到了无以复加的地步。
韩千陌，仙界第一魔帝，超越仙帝境级别的存在！
如今所有人公认的仙界魔道第一人！
而且，韩千陌最特别的地方在于，对方与其他的魔道高手完全不一样，他心狠手段不假，但却从不伤及无辜，绝对算得上魔道中的一股清流。
“陈仙师，您…您真的认识韩魔帝？”王倩有点儿不敢相信。
陈凡还未回答，洛千凝便提他答道：“马上自然，我夫君不但认识韩千陌，而且还对他有大恩！韩千陌曾发誓，我夫君的任何要求，他都会照做。”

“什么？！”王倩这一刻，直接原地石化。
她看的出来，洛千凝绝对没有在说大话，对方实力深不可测，也根本没必要对她一个小小玄仙信口开河。
陈凡到底是什么样的存在？！
竟然能让魔帝韩千陌都对他唯命是从？！
王倩在震惊之余，真正看到了希望，原本她以为自己余生能躲在这处山洞内度日，就已经是最好的结果了。
但现在看来，她的余生还有救！
content_en:
Chapter 2229 Promises and Lies
Looking at Wang Qian in front of her, Luo Qianning's eyes were full of pity.
She finally understood what was special about the other party in Chen Fan's words.
However, for Wang Qian, this is simply an unparalleled disaster!
Of course, Wang Qian was very clear about her situation. After all, Chen Fan had already told her when she met Chen Fan, but it was just not as detailed as what Luo Qianning said at the moment.
"Master Luo Immortal is really powerful. I was indeed tricked. Now, whether in the eyes of the righteous or the evil, I am like a tonic. Fortunately, Master Chen took pity on me and found this place for me to settle down. Otherwise, I would have been dead long ago..."
When Wang Qian said this, she couldn't help but feel sad.
Luo Qianning watched the scene in front of her quietly, feeling more and more pity in her heart, and said softly: "From now on, you can practice here with peace of mind, protected by the sword array of the sword pavilion. Most people can hurt you at all, but if you want to fundamentally solve the problem, you must practice a powerful magic skill and cleanse yourself again."
"Powerful magic..." Wang Qian couldn't help but shake her head after hearing this, "It's easier said than done. If I really encounter a powerful magic fairy, I'm afraid it will directly kill me!"
Luo Qianning nodded helplessly. The fact is just as Wang Qian said. The other party's current situation requires him to practice a powerful magic skill, so that he can be reborn and offset the problems caused by his own practice of "Xuan Miao Jue".
However, most people in the demonic path are unscrupulous in their actions. In their eyes, Wang Qian is like a peerless fairy grass!
Who would save her instead of killing her?
At this time, Chen Fan said: "Don't worry, you can practice here with peace of mind. I said I will help you to the end. When I meet Han Qianmo, I can help you get out of the quagmire."
Wang Qian couldn't help but be surprised when she heard the name 'Han Qianmo'. She had heard Chen Fan say before that he would help her find a magic master, but Chen Fan didn't say who it was at that time.
At this moment, Chen Fan suddenly mentioned the other party's name, and Wang Qian froze on the spot, her heart shocked beyond measure.
Han Qianmo, the first demon emperor in the immortal world, an existence beyond the level of the immortal emperor!
Now everyone recognizes him as the number one person in the magic world!
Moreover, the most special thing about Han Qianmo is that he is completely different from other magic masters. He is cruel and cruel, but he never hurts innocent people. He is definitely a breath of fresh air in the magic world.
"Master Chen Xian, you... do you really know Demon Emperor Han?" Wang Qian couldn't believe it.
Before Chen Fan could answer, Luo Qianning reminded him and replied: "Surely, my husband not only knows Han Qianmo, but is also very kind to him! Han Qianmo once swore that he would comply with any request of my husband."
"What?!" Wang Qian turned to stone at this moment.
She could tell that Luo Qianning was definitely not talking nonsense. The opponent's strength was unfathomable, and there was no need to talk nonsense to a little fairy like her.
What kind of existence is Chen Fan? !
How could he actually make Demon Emperor Han Qianmo obey his orders? !
Wang Qian was shocked and finally saw hope. She originally thought that hiding in this cave for the rest of her life would be the best outcome.
But now it seems that she can still save the rest of her life!
